review_description: Opera Solar Energy have done an outstanding job on providing a superb Enphase system on our house!From the outset, Andy provided a heap of extremely valuable advice which helped me make an informed decision. He was always very polite and happily provided thorough answers to all the my questions. He was always very responsive to any questions I sent via text messages.Opera Solar also managed to provide an installation date just before the end of 2024 to ensure that I would receive the maximum rebate, which was greatly appreciated.I'm looking forward to see the results of investing in the Enphase system come to fruition this year and onwards. I'd happily recommend Andy and the Opera Solar Energy team to anyone looking to invest in a solar energy system!

Andy was extremely personable and helpful throughout the whole process. Andy came to our home and assessed the property himself, and showed us what was possible. The Opera Solar staff Brian and Allan were also incredibly professional during the installation, and completed the job efficiently and were very polite. Strongly recommend Opera Solar for anyone looking to install solar into their home in the Hills area.
Great response  time and always happy to find the best solution that meets your needs. Efficient and trouble free solar installation. Post sales support also excellent.

Andy and the team were absolutely amazing through the entire process.Andy is very knowledgeable and sat down with us and worked out what would work best for us.Pricing was amazing and the installers were very nice and explained everything in clear detail.Would highly recommend to family and friends.

Highly knowledgeable, reliable and honest about all things solar. Very reasonable pricing with great brand knoweldge to help you make the right decision. Professional installation with great after-sale support and advice.

Andy and the entire Opera Solar Energy team did a fantastic job at our residence. They were fabulous to deal with from the onset, Andy promptly responded to multiple queries and overall a quality service was provided - Andy and their team booked in an installation date, communicated very well and turned up on the day without any fuss or hassle to complete the job!Would highly recommend Opera Solar Energy without hesitation as your go to solar installer. Thank you Andy and team for the great job!!

Aniket and his team were helpful throughout the process. All queries were addressed promptly and dealt with quality customer service. The installation didn’t take time after signing the quote.The system was installed last month and is producing all the power and a bit more than quoted, which is even better. Power bills are already coming  considerably  lower. The installation team was great and easy to deal with. Installation was clean and quality work. Highly recommended!!

Andy and his team from Opera Solar Energy are fantastic and couldn’t be more accommodating. Great service, upgraded our panels to Hyundai and installed the system in 1 day. Whilst it’s has only been a week or so, I am very happy with the finished product. I look forward to see how the system/install performs in all weather conditions. Andy has followed up after the install and has provided expert advice on use of the system and the App that came with it. I highly recommend Andy and Opera Solar Energy if you are thinking about getting Solar.
